Verify a categorical variable that crossed from one program to another

Source: R/catg.R
xfrvrf.Rd

Checks a categorical column after it was exported by one program and imported by another: the value labels that arrived must agree with the source's code book, and the decoded values must reproduce the counts the source reported. When the column carries a labels attribute it is decoded by it (declbld()); otherwise by codebook; otherwise the values are taken as labels.

Usage

xfrvrf(imported, soucnts, codebook = NULL, tol = 0, strict = TRUE)

Arguments

imported

The column as imported.

soucnts

The counts the source program reported, a named numeric vector (label = count).

codebook

NULL, or the source's code book, a named vector code = label.

tol

The largest difference counted as agreement, one number from 0.

strict

TRUE stops at a failure.

Value

A list of class xfrvrf: ok, decoded (a factor), marginals (the vrfmrg() check), codebook (TRUE, FALSE, or NA when there was nothing to compare) and reasons.

See also

declbld(), vrfmrg().

Examples

imp <- structure(c(1, 2, 2, 1, 1), labels = c(No = 1, Yes = 2))
xfrvrf(imp, c(No = 3, Yes = 2), codebook = c("1" = "No", "2" = "Yes"))
#> xfrvrf: as the source reported 
#> code book: agrees 
#> vrfmrg: the counts match 
#>  label observed published difference
#>     No        3         3          0
#>    Yes        2         2          0
xfrvrf(c("No", "Yes", "Yes"), c(No = 1, Yes = 2))
#> xfrvrf: as the source reported 
#> code book: nothing to compare 
#> vrfmrg: the counts match 
#>  label observed published difference
#>     No        1         1          0
#>    Yes        2         2          0
